title: chrysocephalum apiculatum subsp. gracilescens
intro: Chrysocephalum apiculatum subsp. gracilescens, commonly known as Yellow Button, is a plant species that belongs to the family Asteraceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve wound healing due to its antioxidant and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Yellow Button are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as sesquiterpenes and diterpenes, which have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory and antibacterial activities. Additionally, the plant's bioactive constituents, including flavonoids and phenolic acids, may provide antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects, supporting its use in traditional medicine for various health conditions.
